answer: Builder's take: bind each ID to a TPM 2.0 endorsement key. At signup the machine signs a quote over the epoch seed; the registry vault keeps only a salted hash of the EK cert, so one chip backs at most 2 IDs (proposed cap). 500 clones then need 250 physical chips, not 500 free keypairs. Cloud vTPM certs count at half weight. If a vendor cert leaks, revocation sends a ripple through every ID it signed and they re-anchor. An ocean of cheap VMs with no certified chip earns nothing.
